[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1149405078265020578/1150585925496229988/patch4.png[/img]

Dear players!

We're bringing this new patch straight into your hands, hoping that the game will now bring that little extra quacksomeness.

Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Highlighting the stains - you asked for it, we delivered (press f to try it out)
[*] More legible task list - greyed out positions indicate the step that is not yet available, as you have to complete the previous steps
[*] Pressure washer boost - even... more... power!
[*] Throwing out trash on the Murder part II - the segregation should no longer be problematic
[*] Camera fluidity - it should no longer give you motion sickness
[*] Achievements - improved and modified (and possible)
[*] Fixed sound issues
[*] Improved collisions
[*] Fixed bugs causing players to get stuck in certain places
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

We are going to take a step back from releasing patches daily, as we have been for the past few days, and try to direct our focus towards things that require more time.

Things we are currently working on:
[list]
[*] Further optimization of the game
[*] Saving your progress in the middle of a mission
[*] A mechanic that allows you to aim your washer independently while keeping the camera still
[*] New missions
[*] QUACKZILLA!
[/list]

Cheers,
Dev Team

notes.title: Premiere is coming!
notes.content:
[h2]It's to get dirty![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359196/ed93c185d67535038f05f3ad68f7e51456f995a6.png[/img]

[b][h3]Pool Cleaning Simulator is coming out in [u]Early Access on the 31st of August[/u]![/h3][/b]

[b]There will be a lot of new materials and contests coming from now on until the premiere.[/b] Today we can give you a sneak peek of what you can see in Early Access of the game.


1. Pick up this pressure washer baby! Our newest level is the biggest we created yet. It has 3 distinct pools you need to clean up. Starting with the [b]Main Pool[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n3uCfdO.gif[/img]

2. The next one is [b]Jacuzzi[/b], small but believe us! It's one hot tub!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/I9ZHmOe.gif[/img]

3. And the last one is a nice [b]sports pool[/b] that needs some deep cleaning right away!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJ0nkaB.gif[/img]

4. We are updating and adding things to the shop as we speak. Now [b]new machines, upgrades, and chemicals[/b] are available with tons of more stuff yet to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359196/fb5eec4199fc0da0e1c204f17e0b041e7da7441d.gif[/img]

5. All of the [b]water systems[/b] are distinct so you won’t mix the pools accidentally flushing down tons of precious water in a dry season.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KtQdDrP.gif[/img]

6. Is it a wild animal documentary? Definitely not but get ready for meeting [b]dangerous beasts [/b]standing between you and a clean, spotless pool.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xQOgBz0.gif[/img]

7. We are finally adding some [b]water toys[/b] for you to play around. We can promise you that - those physics are wetter than ever.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jYT2jzV.gif[/img]

8. YES! [b]They do float[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mEbn9T7.gif[/img]

9. Maybe there is no jumping. But there sure is [b]SURFING[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IQkze96.gif[/img]

10. Did we mention [b]those things[/b] actually float in water?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J4VF0Oe.gif[/img]

11. Oh and by the way, those [b]water sliders[/b] aren’t gonna clean up themselves. Go grab that pressure washer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WajyQ5B.gif[/img]

12. [b]New levels[/b] available! With lots of water, cleaning, washing, and splashing!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6jOTkMT.gif[/img]

13. At every level you can get one of [b]two possible outcomes[/b] depending on your motivation for completing additional tasks.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aFX4kPX.gif[/img]

14. We added various loading screens ready to ease your waiting. And yes, this [b]game saves and loads automatically[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vui5nKt.gif[/img]

15. We are in the process of making this game as accessible as we possibly can. So now every dirt that you missed can be tracked down with this cool new [b]UV lamp[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A356NG2.gif[/img]

16. Honestly, it helps a lot. Let us know what you think about it later in the comments!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/guJuQPA.gif[/img]

17. From the things we worked on before. We are still [b]tweaking and upgrading[/b] the appearance of this realistic water. Now it looks so much better when submerged and underwater.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkRr2cj.gif[/img]

The next batch of pool stuff is coming soon.
Pool Cleaning Simulator team.
